title: Streamlined format for Toxicological Sciences: still your science, your journal
content: Toxicological Sciences continually evolves to meet the publishing needs of toxicologists and to improve the quality of the journal. This editorial highlights some recent adjustments made to Toxicological Sciences in an ever-changing publication landscape. For example, have you checked out our LinkedIn Trainee Author Spotlights (https://www.linkedin.com/company/toxicological-sciences)? We actively engage our authors and want to increase the impact of your and your trainees’ efforts. Each accepted paper is promoted on LinkedIn upon publication to Advance Access, and the final version is promoted again during the issue cover month. Be sure to connect with us and share your colleagues’ impactful toxicology research.
